scoreContext: Comparative style/readability evidence only. Approval rests on visible outcomes and the preserved native contract, not a score threshold.
observations: The entrance is visibly softer and more dimensional than the original at 576x448: lantern shoulders and paper bodies have rounded soft light; brass bands remain distinct; wooden jambs, brackets, feet and threshold edges have controlled highlights.

The blue canopy retains its flat-slab construction and darker fascia, while bevel light makes the slab edges legible. Gold lanterns, ochre wall fields, warm brown wood, red cloth and cream fish retain the original palette hierarchy.

Three red panels have gentle edge turns and soft broad tonal variation; the cream fish remains continuous, readable and correctly placed. The treatment is quieter than the target but meets the chosen soft cartoon style without copying cyan gloss, mottling or halo.

The dark navy doorway remains a coherent intentional recess, and the muted threshold remains a distinct step. Dark fittings and fabric gaps are intentional. No unintended black patch, clipped emblem, disconnected hanger/band, merged panel edge, exposed geometry or alpha fringe was found.

The previous RGB seam blocker is resolved. Independently assembled entrance boundaries x=1248 and 2784 and repeated wall boundaries x=480,864,3168,3552,3936 no longer produce the repeating dark/light vertical line across wall fields or baseboard. Intended-size repeated preview is continuous; native-scale RGB evidence supports that observation.

Independent RGB row 900 samples at wall join x=480 stay around [177,145,94], rather than round-05's drop to[168,136,88]. Baseboard row 1200 stays around [164–165,112,60..61], rather than the previous [153,103,56] dip. Entrance boundary samples show only small local lighting/sample variation without a coherent dark/light seam.

The native connected and independently assembled facades agree in continuous roof/fascia, blank wall field and baseboard treatment. There is no broad horizontal module gradient or directional ground shadow. Wall context labels remain explicit and do not imply wall approval.
Disabling denoising leaves faint fine sampling grain only when inspecting the native export closely. At intended size the surfaces read smooth and quiet; this creates no material defect or new seam.

resolvedPreviousBlockers.result: Resolved: RGB continuity now holds visually at both entrance boundaries and repeated wall boundaries; verified with actual independent/native pixels rather than alpha alone.

remainingDifferences: Roof and timber are more restrained in saturation/gloss than the fixed target; this preserves original color identity and avoids plastic glare.
Cloth folds and surface detail remain simpler than the imagegen treatment, with sufficient edge turning and tonal variation for intended-size readability.
The target's alpha noise, colored halo, canvas drift, mottled walls and strong wall gradients remain absent.
Fine stochastic render variation is visible only at native close inspection and is accepted because it is quiet at intended size.
Internal bevels produce a subpixel projected-height difference (2.99904269 tiles versus source declared 3), while original frame, root, join planes and contacts remain fixed.
